hypothesis: E110 showed every world goes extinct without the floor. A diagnosis (seed 888035, controlled reruns; 2026-11-05) traced it to the toxic cap: it fruits from year phase 0.5 (tick 72000), edible patches are grazed to their stock floor, so new spawns into freed food slots are mostly toxic caps; nothing eats them, they live 24000 ticks and hold up to 1700 of 2400 slots, and edible inflow falls from 471k to 178k energy per 1k ticks while demand stays flat. flora.toxiccap.share 0 removed the crash on 888035 and toxicity 0 on 224570; life 4000 alone, maxFood 4800 alone and yield 0.05 alone did not. Overshoot, patch death, the season table, herds and disease were ruled out as causes. In nature an unpalatable plant spreads under heavy grazing but does not take every gap, because edible plants re-establish too; the levers make the cap take fewer gaps or hold them for less time.
prediction: 8 seeds x 200000 ticks, all arms on floorTrigger 0 (evals/screens/toxic-cap.grid.json). Defaults: extinct on 8/8 seeds. cap-off: survives to 200k on at least 6/8 seeds (the control showing the mechanism). cap-share-1-yield and cap-share-1-recover: survive on at least 5/8. cap-share-1 alone: delays the crash but survives on at most 4/8. cap-tox-0.3: survives on at least 5/8 if a mildly toxic cap gets eaten enough to free its slots. cap-short: survives on at most 4/8. recover alone: still extinct on most seeds (it acts after the crash). Keep rule: the arm survives (population above 0 at 200k) on at least 6/8 seeds with the floor off and holds at least 3 prey types at the end; among keepers prefer the one that keeps the toxic cap (prey types, eval.toxic_avoidance), not cap-off. A kept arm is confirmed on 16 seeds with the floor on (the shipped default) against the defaults before adoption.

Fewer caps (share 1) do not stop the crash: the slots they take are held 24000 ticks, so the lifetime, not the spawn share, sets how much of the stock is inedible once maxFood has room.
